2024

Author: Sandeep Kumar
Bench: Sandeep Kumar
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna
 Criminal Miscellaneous No.75912 of 2024
 Arising Out of Ps. Case No.-148 Year-2023 Thana- Alipur Distric
 ======================================================
 Ajit Kumar @ Ajit Ram S/O Late Janeshwar Ram @ Bhola Ram R/O Vill.-
 Ithori, P.S.- Alipur, Dist.- Gaya.

sentences.text:

 Versus  The State of Bihar  ... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Shivendra Prasad, Advocate  For the State : Mr.Pramod Kumar Pandey, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 11-12-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. Earlier the prayer for bail of the petitioner was rejected vide order dated 14.03.2024 in Cr. Misc.
No. 18359 of 2024.
3. The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Alipur P.S. Case No. 148 of 2023 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467 and 468 of the Indian Penal Code.

4. The petitioner is accused of committing fraud on the promise of getting loan and thereafter, the petitioner and the other accused persons prepared forged documents and take money from the gullible persons.
The petitioner is in jail since 18.10.2023 and his trial has not yet commenced.
5. In view of the delay in trial, this application is Patna High Court CR.

6. Let the petitioner, above named, be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned ACJM-VI,

1 Gaya in connection with Alipur P.S. Case No. 148 of 2023.
7.

Any default in appearance at the Police Station would be result in cancellation of bail bonds of the petitioner.
